SAY: I’m glad we both prioritize quiet and cleanliness, Priya!  

PFR:wfh=No, I’m on campus daily; noise=Very quiet, minimal guests, volume low after 10 pm; guests=Never or very rare, but I can allow a single weekend visit per month with at least 24 hr notice.  

FLX:guests=Agree to limit any guest visits to once a month with prior notice, matching my quiet‑room preference.
